expected_value_creation: Pre-implementation QIF guidance will help users block poor solution framing, missing negative acceptance, data-boundary confusion, and concept-comprehension failures before work is built.
beneficiary: Standalone QIF users, repository reviewers, document reviewers, product teams, operations teams, and AI agents
supporting_evidence: The retrospective identifies concrete failures that passed post-implementation gates but could have been caught by Loss Boundaries, negative acceptance, and pre-implementation quality review.
QIF v0.3 Discovery Layer already defines discovery patterns and candidate Quality Intents that can be extended with solution-bias, boundary-confusion, and concept-comprehension discovery.
success_criteria: Docs define a reusable pre-implementation review workflow that is not AOF-specific.
Docs define negative acceptance and examples across UI, data, documents, operations, and agent work.
